# Akhil Vanga

> Senior UX and AI-first Product Designer based in Sacramento, California, with 12+ years of experience across aviation, healthcare, and government. AI-first product design is the central theme, demonstrated by the live UX Architect tool, AI-assisted review workflows, end-to-end design ownership, and reusable systems.

## Scope and evidence
The portfolio presents individual design ownership, not prior people-management experience. Akhil is seeking staff-level individual-contributor or hands-on UX lead opportunities; these are target roles, not claimed employment titles. The CCS+ time-reduction figure is a feedback-based estimate, and Axiom CI screen counts are illustrative workflow data rather than measured business outcomes.

## Portfolio
- [Home](https://www.akhilvanga.com/): Background, capabilities, selected work, and contact information.
- [CCS+ Trade Center](https://www.akhilvanga.com/work/ccs-trade-center): United Airlines pilot scheduling and trip-trading UX case study.
- [Axiom CI](https://www.akhilvanga.com/work/axiom-ci): AI-assisted contract and invoice review, evidence, and commercial decisions.
- [Design System](https://www.akhilvanga.com/design-system): Themeable React and TypeScript components, design tokens, and live examples.
- [UX Architect](https://www.akhilvanga.com/ux-architect): Interactive tool for product briefs, personas, journeys, and wireframe blueprints.
